# pvecli storage

Manage storage.

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`add`](add.md) | Add a shared storage to the cluster, checking every node can reach it. |
| [`remove`](remove.md) | Remove a storage definition. The data on the backend is left untouched. |
| [`config`](config.md) | Configure storage content types interactively. |
| [`content`](content.md) | Manage storage content. |
| [`list`](list.md) | List all storage. |
| [`info`](info.md) | Show detailed storage information and configuration. |
